lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno tried to grow some wings,
And spin his head like owl things!
Kiki hooted, that's not right,
A night owl just stays up at night!
[chorus]
Night owl, night owl,
Up so late, wise and proud!
Night owl, night owl,
Wide awake when the moon is out!
[verse]
It means a person who stays up late,
Reading, working, after eight,
When others sleep, they're wide awake,
Night owls love the night, no mistake!
[chorus]
Night owl, night owl,
Up so late, wise and proud!
Night owl, night owl,
Stars are shining, say it loud!
[outro]
So if you're up when stars are bright,
You're a night owl, say goodnight!
